items.raw_excerpt: A long-awaited plan to make public transport between Austria's Salzburg and a part of neighbouring Bavaria in southern Germany more straightforward has received around €750,000 in European funding.
items.summary_en: A plan to improve public transport between Salzburg in Austria and Bavaria in southern Germany has received about 750,000 euros in EU funding. The long-awaited project will make it easier for people to cross the border by train or bus. Both sides say the improved links will help residents and visitors travel more simply between the two regions.

items.title_en: Cross-border transport between Salzburg and Bavaria to get easier after EU funding boost

items.raw_excerpt: Although more people are returning their cans and bottles for recycling and cash back, the mandatory collection target of 90% is not being met, just as it hasn’t since the deposit scheme was first introduced five years ago. According to Verpact, the foundation that oversees the statiegeld (deposit) system in the Netherlands, based on figures from the first half of the year, 78% of deposit bottles will be collected in 2026; for cans, that number jumps to 86%. Since 2021,...
items.summary_en: More people in the Netherlands are returning bottles and cans for their deposit money. Still, the country is not reaching its mandatory 90% recycling target. The expected rate is 78% for bottles and 86% for cans in 2026.
